notes.title: Hotfix Deployed
notes.content:
Greeting Space Realtors!

The Red Planet update released the other week—check it out if you haven't already! This Hot Fix should resolve some of the issues we caught over the weekend, along with some minor improvements and adjustments.

[b]Improvements & Squashed Bugs:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fuseburner Project: [spoiler] Increased zone radius of final fight [/spoiler]
[*] Fuseburner Project: [spoiler] Added missing sound to exploding toasters [/spoiler]
[*] Fixed bug where sounds registered from astronaut could literally fall of the character and roll away
[*] Decorated the ship
[*] Fixed issue in radial menu when switching tools
[*] Fixed issue where pick-ups in the Mechanoid Rescue event could spawn inside rocks on the Red Planet
[*] Various minor fixes and polish
[/list]

We appreciate all the feedback and bugs that you have sent in so far. If you have ideas or feedback, we’d love for you to join us over on Discord.

As always, thank you for playing and see you in space! 🚀

/Simon

notes.title: Update.02: The Red Planet
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to “Helnera”: The Red Planet[/h1]
Greetings Space Realtors!

The Red Planet update is here, and we couldn’t be more excited to introduce you to Helnera!

Close to the local star, this sizzling world offers HOT beaches, rich natural resources, and 11 exciting regions to uncover. From arid mountains to acidic peninsulas and the smoldering heart of Mount Deth, there’s no shortage of real estate opportunities—or challenges!

[previewyoutube=2lyrIdtRmmQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]New Helneran Creatures, World Features & Constructions:[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Bollwarks[/b]
[i]Skilled builders who prefer their privacy but can become aggressively protective of their homes. Best to keep things neighborly unless you want trouble![/i]
[*][b]Stonecrows[/b]
[i]These rare creatures defy biology and geology alike. Catching a closer look might unlock new research, but good luck—they're as skittish as they are fascinating.[/i]
[*][b]World Feature: “Mount Deth”[/b]
[i]Despite the intimidating name, Mount Deth (which totally means “friendship” in the ancient Hoxolot language) is a prime source of energy. Harnessing its lava flow with the right tech could be a game-changer![/i]
[*][b]Base Building: “Synthide Extractor”[/b]
[i]Extract valuable Synthetics from Helnera’s mineral-rich soil to fuel your expansion.[/i]
[/list]
[h2]New Main Project and Events[/h2]
On top of the new planet we are also introducing a bunch of new events to be explored. Note that these can be played on both the new red planet Helnera, as well as the previous green planet Autica.

[list]
[*][b]Main Project: “Fuseburner Contract”[/b]
[i]Team up with the eccentric Sir Fuseburner to prototype an invention, come up with a stellar marketing strategy, and (hopefully) prosper![/i]
[*][b]Event: “Galob Predicament”[/b]
[i]Someone’s in a sticky situation on the planet, and their distress signal is counting on you to save them.[/i]
[*][b]Event: “Crusty Crustaceans”[/b]
[i]The elusive subterranean Rock Lobster has emerged—and its odd behavior might just spell trouble!
General Improvements[/i]
[/list]
An update wouldn’t be complete without us sprucing things up and tweaking. Below, you’ll find a list of improvements and bug fixes!
[list]
[*] Revised multiplayer connectivity
[*] Interface Polish: Updated glyphs and icons, increased readability,  layout adjustments, color tuning and much more!
[*] Enabled deletion of developments: Sometimes you need to abandon something to start over fresh!
[*] Overhauled the Controller Legend page in settings
[*] Tuned the Camera Sensitivity parameters for a literally smoother experience
[*] Improved performance on Spaceship
[/list]
[b]Squashed Bugs:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added description for “Young Blarfair” construction
[*] Removed some interaction quirks occurring in the toolbox for clients 
[*] “Dots” in the Codex now updates individually in multiplayer
[*] Curated the creatures preview images in the Codex
[*] Various minor fixes syncing issues in multiplayer
[*] Fixed an issue of clients not able to move buildings in base correctly
[*] Stopped Region and Hub summary windows from stacking on top of each other in the Teleporter map
[*] Fixed an issue where an World Feature could be improved on twice for clients in multiplayer
[*] Removed unnecessary glyphs in some cutscenes
[*] Fixed various instances of music not triggering correctly
[*] Features that are blocked for the client in multiplayer now display messages when tried to be interacted with.
[*] Fixed interfaces not adjusting correctly when playing the game in 16:10
[*] Removed instances of players turning invisible in multiplayer
[*] Various minor fixes to interfaces
[*] Fixed pot holes on the Green Planet where the player could walk into the environment
[*] Added text to some descriptions that were missing
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could disable interaction on the Spaceship when switching between languages
[*] Added and updated various icons
[*] Fixed issue where transfer from dead player storage to inventory did not behave correctly
[*] Clients now pointing in correct direction when spawning from building their houses
[*] Rewrote some text for clearer instructions in objectives that were vague
[*] Active gadgets and tool positions in Radial Menu is now saved between sessions
[*] Clients can now hold their picnic basket correctly
[*] Fixed instance of Mini Map markers duplicating for client in multiplayer
[*] Refinery interface now update correctly for client in multiplayer
[/list]

For those returning since the Lift-Off update back in September, you can also look forward to a good number of UI improvements and general fixes from our interim updates released during our work on the Red Planet, including:
[list]
[*] Interface Glow-Up: Status, Faction, and the Objectives pages has received lots of love for smoother navigation, better overview and in general a more stylish look!
[*] Dynamic Resolution Upgrades: New settings and expanded support for a wider range of setups
[*] Gamepad Love: Improved Codex navigation and updated legends—gamepad users, enjoy!
[*] Cleaner Views: Hide UI glyphs with a new toggle
[*] World Map Overhaul: Hover for instant context—no more flipping between menus!
[*] Tooltip For Everyone: Inspection and Tooltips added to interfaces like the World Map, Crafting & Storage UIs, the Market Prospect, and more.
[*] Audio Upgrade: Enhanced sound effects for buildings, and your trusty wrench—what does the frog say? SPLAT!
[*] Early Access Reminder: A shiny new label in the main menu to remind you that the best is yet to come.
[*] Extra Polish: A sprinkle of improvements across various icons and interfaces for that final touch!
[/list]
For the whole list of improvements and squashed bugs featured in the interim updates, see linked discussion thread of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1624060/discussions/0/6324829427686588833/]Past Patch Notes[/url]


[b]We can’t wait for you to dive into Helnera and make it your own! As always, we’d love to hear your thoughts on Discord.

Thank you for playing, and we’ll see you on Helnera![/b]

notes.title: Patch Release: MORE UI Improvements
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Space Realtors![/h1]

As we continue crafting the Red Planet update, we wanted to share some fresh improvements we've been working on in the meantime. This latest update comes packed with UI polish, added support for performance settings, and plenty of bug fixes to keep everything running smoothly.

As always, if you have ideas or feedback, we’d love for you to join us over on Discord. Your input shapes Space for Sale as we head closer to the Red Planet update, and we can’t wait to bring you along for the journey.

Thanks for being part of the journey, and see you in space!

/Simon

[h2]Changelog:[/h2]

[b]Improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] Codex now updates correctly for all clients—no more missing intel!
[*] Status Page overhaul: clearer progression tracking and easier readability
[*] Faction sub-page polished for smooth navigation and better overview
[*] Objectives page improved for easier readability
[*] Various localisation fixes
[*] Dynamic Resolution got an upgrade, with new settings and expanded support for a wider range of setups
[*] Refreshed icons for that extra visual polish
[*] Updated gamepad legends
[*] Added a toggle in settings to hide UI glyphs if you’re into a cleaner look
[*] Improved Codex navigation with a gamepad
[*] The Video settings tab is now scrollable
[*] Added an “Early Access” label to the main menu—just to remind you, there’s more coming!
[/list]

[b]Squashed Bugs:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issues with client connectivity in some edge cases
[*] The Edit Profile buttons are now up to standard with other interfaces
[*] Made glyphs update more reliable when switching between keyboard and gamepad
[*] Fixed an exploit where a client could bring along space money and food when joining
[*] Fixed cases where players could turn invisible in multiplayer
[*] Made various fixes for togglable settings updating correctly
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Release: UI Improvements
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings Space Realtors![/h2]

While we're hard at work on the Red Planet update we were thinking we'd serve you guys some fixes that's been made along the way. These fixes mostly relate to UI improvements, expanding on the World Map UIs as well as adding additional tooltips. We've also added more juice to blocker removal (Dynamite go "BOOM!"), multiple sound effects and squashed a lot of bugs during this patching period. 

Hope you enjoy the update! If you want to get in touch we encourage you to join the community on Discord! We'd love to hear what you want from Space for Sale in the future as we make our way towards the Red Planet update!

Thank you for playing and See you in Space! 
/Toby

[h2]Changelog:[/h2]

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The World Map is visually updated and the context information, when hovering elements on the map, has received a major improvement. No more switching between interfaces to get the full picture!
[*] Inspection functionality and tooltips has been added to items in various interfaces:
  - The summary windows in the World Map; such as the Region Summary 
  - Storage interfaces; such as the Item Storage in the HUB
  - Crafting interfaces; such as the refinery
  - The Resource top bar
  - The Toolbox Interface
  - The Components tab in the Codex
  - The Market Prospect Interface
[*] Support for different sounds depending on what surface you hit with the wrench. What sound does the frog make? SPLAT! 
[*] Added visuals and sound effects when you remove debris blocking the World Features
[*] Buildings have been updated with sound effects
[*] A bunch of polish and improvements to various interfaces and icons
[*] Various localisation fixes
[/list]
[h3]Squashed Bugs:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a case where opening a Objective notification didn’t lead the player to the correct objective page
[*] Made the Market escapable when clicking ESC using keyboard
[*] Development Cards in the “Select Development” interface now show the correct time displayed.
[*] Silently removed some rogue objective notifications that shouldn’t be visible while on the ship.
[*] Removed Interface Color Preset from the Settings menu
[*] Made the text shown above the Waypoint marker on the Word Map disappear correctly when not hovered upon
[*] Made the Supporter Kit wrench display correctly when traveling between the ship and planets
[*] Added text to various items where it was missing
[*] Increased the scrolling speed of the HUB Storage when using a mouse wheel
[*] Added more beeeeees (that you can whack and toss) when the Fragrant Spheroid is deployed
[*] Made the Bloomin Blarfair event complete with a proper checkbox on the final objective step.
[*] Stopped some codex notifications from appearing again when restarting the game
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Greetings Space Realtors! 

Since launch Space For Sale has gotten one big update and multiple patches that focused on addressing community feedback as well as squashing bugs. We wanted to prioritise our first wave of players, to make sure that we reacted to what you were saying in a timely manner. This meant that the Demo has remained in a pre-launch state—but with this update, that is no longer the case! 

The Demo will be similar in regards to content but it reaps tons of benefits from the patches with improvements to UI/UX, gameplay, visuals and performance! 

So if you've been on the fence about Space for Sale, this is a great time to try out the demo! 

Thank you for playing and See you in Space! 
/Toby

[b][i]NOTE: The Demo update is not compatible with older save files. Save files from before this update will not be shown in the planet select UI.[/i][/b]

[h2]Changelog:[/h2]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added directional arrow to building holograms.
[*] Improved hologram visualization.
[*] Made resources global.
[*] Removed shipping costs.
[*] Removed Silos from the Construction Menu.
[*] Made the Hub have global storage.
[*] Updated the client houses to better profile their respective faction.
[*] Various fixes to colliders of constructions.
[*] Added highlighting of newly unlocked construction in the construction menu.
[*] Region summary and Hub summary will now be visible on the Teleporter map.
[*] Added “Hints” that shows information in article form when relevant.
[*] Cost and yield info of improved world features is now displayed if you hover on their icons on the World Map.
[*] Updated region summary in World Map with produced and consumed resources instead of available resources.
[*] Updated colors in profile creation.
[*] Updated layout in profile creation.
[*] Adjusted scale of buildings and constructions.
[*] Adjusted required cost of some buildings.
[*] Added splashing effect when stepping into water.
[*] Added option to allow specific audio output selection.
[*] Various improvements to Codex tab in the Pause Menu.
[*] When using keyboard & mouse: “B” has been replaced with “I” to open inventory.
[*] Polished construction VFXs.
[*] Polished Hub site shield to not show weird behaviour in certain angles.
[*] Made clients disappear when deconstructing their respective house.
[*] Made tenant dialogue boxes more readable.
[*] Increased the speed of the jackhammer.
[*] Made it possible to move built constructions in base site.
[*] “Unsafed” the buggy.
[*] Numerous localization improvements.
[*] Made various adjustments to tenant visuals and their animations.
[*] Made it not possible for constructions to be built outside of Hub site shield.
[*] Added a Market that lets you import and export resources (minerals, biofuel, organics, etc.) - It’s available in the Hub UI!
[*] Improved visuals of “hold button” action prompts.
[*] Replaced worker slot icon.
[*] Added tooltips to various UI:s.
[*] Reworked the Factions window in the status tab.
[*] Reworked the resource information into a top bar.
[*] Reworked the information displayed when building constructions into pop ups.
[*] Added a cut scene when building a construction for the first time.
[*] Updated various icons in the construction menu.
[*] Localized the “Preview Limitation” text in the Prospect Market UI.
[*] Increased scroll speed in Storage UIs.
[*] Various UI Polish.
[/list]

[h3]Squashed Bugs:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed various colliders.
[*] Players are now less likely to get stuck in ragdoll state.
[*] The spaceship is now not able to show up on the planet.
[*] Made player less likely to get stuck under a buggy if they flip it on top of themselves.
[*] Fixed some issues with scanning not progressing research.
[*] Title is now displayed on the storage of deconstructed buggies.
[*] Made items held in hand drop when using a teleporter instead of disappearing.
[*] Made dialogue not be able to start when in menus.
[*] Removed the “Interface Color Preset” setting.
[*] Made player spawn in expected Hub base when loading a save.
[*] 1920 x 1200 no longer cut off the border of some UIs.
[*] Various fixes related to UI interactions.
[*] Holograms are no longer animated, making it easier to read their size and position.
[*] Made the “Invert Camera” setting save correctly between play sessions.
[*] Improved the crafting interaction in the Refinery.
[*] Flowers no longer look like they are trying to strangle a player when they walk through them.
[/list]

notes.title: Update.01: Lift-Off - Released!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=lwH8Zj-e4fY;full][/previewyoutube]
Greetings Space Realtors! 📢

The first update for Space for Sale: [b]Lift-Off[/b] - is finally out! 

A month ago Space for Sale launched and what a month it has been! We've been getting tons of great feedback from our players, some of which we hope to adress in this update! 

Full changelog below, highlights include:
[list]
[*] A New Event ”[b]Bloomin’ Blarfairs[/b]” 🌻
[*] New and updated Constructions
[*] Movable Constructions 
[*] Resource Trading
[*] Global Hub Inventory
[*] UI Improvements
[*] Tutorial Improvements
[/list]
We would like to thank everyone who has embarked on their Space Realty journey, It's been such a joy watching people finally play and interact with our game! If you haven't already consider joining the community on Discord! 

https://discord.gg/spaceforsale


We hope you enjoy [b]Update.01: Lift-Off[/b] and that you'll come along as we move onward toward the next update "[b]Update.02: The Red Planet[/b]". 

Thank you for playing and see you in space! 🚀

[h2]Changelog:[/h2]

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Mechanoid is now able to hangout with and perform activities similar to other clients (fishing, [*] sunbathing, etc.)
[*] Made Hub site shield look better in certain angles
[*] Made clients actually go away when you deconstruct their houses
[*] Increased the speed of the jackhammer
[*] Opened up the closed road between regions “Follies Fairground” and “Manglers Ridge”
[*] Made it possible to move constructions in base site
[*] Made the “Logistics Centre” animate with drones sorting and delivering crates.
[*] “Unsafed” the buggy.
[*] Made it not possible for constructions to be built while sticking out of Hub site shield
[*] Improved the Demaws hunt animations
[*] Added a Market that lets you import and export resources (minerals, biofuel, organics, etc.) - It’s available in the Hub UI!
[*] Made resources global
[*] Removed Silos from the Construction Menu
[*] Removed shipping costs
[*] Added new event: “Bloomin’ Blarfair” - Team up with a space gardener to save the unique Blarfair flowers.
[*] Made the Hub have global storage
[*] Updated the Exogarden construction
[*] Updated the client houses to better profile their respective faction
[*] Made it not possible to scan a world feature if there is a Blocker sitting on top of it
[*] Improved the targeting of the Jackhammer
[*] Expanded ending of Main Project: S.I.T. Contract to be more satisfying
[*] Made various improvement to marker stability in world map
[*] Replaced worker slot icon
[*] Added tooltips to various UI:s
[*] Updated the Factions window in the status tab
[*] Reworked the resource information into a top bar
[*] Reworked the information displayed when building constructions into pop ups
[*] Added a cutscene when building a construction for the first time
[*] Updated various icons in the construction menu
[*] Added special rule: “Limited to one per region” and “Limited to one per development” to one-of-a-kind buildings in construction menu
[*] Added highlighting of newly unlocked construction in the construction menu
[*] Region summary and Hub summary will now be visible on the Teleporter map
[*] Replaced icon of the Bottle of Goop item
[*] Cost and yield info of improved world features is now displayed if you hover on their icons on the World Map.
[*] Updated region summary in World Map with produced and consumed resources instead of available resources
[*] Made hollow tree tunnels more easy to pass through
[*] Removed “Difficult Terrain” modifier since we no longer have “Shipping Costs” in game
[*] Changed “Logistics Centre” reward since we no longer have “Shipping Costs” in game
[*] Adjusted UI of “Construction Activation” UI to accommodate long text
[*] Shaved off ca 2 seconds of the cutscene when clients move in
[*] Increased time slightly when crafting tools in the Workbench
[*] Made the Construction Kit research project slightly easier to accomplish
[*] Made the Snitch creature flee when you chase it in a buggy
[*] Increased scroll speed in Storage UIs
[*] Added building “Experimental Power Plant”
[/list]

[h3]Squashed Bugs:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Made “Observer Kit” completable while modifier “Peaceful” is toggled on - Ashdillos can now drop scales by several methods
[*] Fixed rules to the building “Homeowners Association”
[*] Fixed various colliders
[*] Players are now less likely to get stuck in ragdoll state
[*] The spaceship is now not able to show up on the planet
[*] Made player less likely to get stuck under a buggy if they flip it on top of themselves
[*] Fixed some issues with scanning not progressing research
[*] Removed “Q” icon from HUD while on the spaceship
[*] Made the “Invert Camera” setting save correctly between play sessions
[*] Improved the crafting interaction in the Refinery.
[*] Added a title to the storage of deconstructed buggies
[*] Made Frog Kit display correctly on the Kit Hanger
[*] Made items held in hand drop when using a teleporter instead of disappearing
[*] Made dialogue not be able to start when in menus
[*] Made various fixes to the S.I.T. Project
[*] Made so that the multiplayer client’s colors are not reset when they die
[*] Players can no longer build constructions on top of each other in multiplayer
[*] Multiplayer clients can now hear the objective complete music
[*] Fixed several minor synching issues for the multiplayer client
[*] Made so that the Mechanoid cannot spawn outside of the map
[*] Grayed out the “Save” button for the multiplayer client in the System Menu
[*] Unfortunate parking no longer causes player to enter ragdoll state when landing on planet
[*] Made various minor fixes to UI
[*] The Bottle of Goop item will no longer turn into a Squeaky Toy when equipped from ground…
[*] Removed the “Interface Color Preset” setting
[*] Fixed issue of the anchor of the Professor’s house sometimes disappearing

notes.title: Update.01: Lift-Off - imminent!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=j9f1v4EaR0Q;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Greetings Space Realtors![/b]

We are so excited to present to you our first proper update of our Roadmap for Space for Sale; [b]Lift-Off.[/b] 

The game has been out for a month now and we’ve been getting tons of great feedback from our players and this update aims to remedy a lot of those points! Our focus was on expanding the available planet, Autica as well as UI improvements, and improving the clarity of the game's resource management and reputation systems.

Let’s get into the details!

[b]NEW EVENT[/b]
Starting off; we’re happy to present a new event : Bloomin' Blarfairs. It’s up to you to help the Glorpian Gardener Glick Glorpenschmirz in her mission to attract Bombus Meliplanians, or Space Bees, to your planet and save the elusive Blarfair Flower. They’re fickle little bastards so it’s going to require vigilance and a good throwing arm to get the job done!

We have improved the Ending of the Main Project with Professor V. Smart adding a more satisfactory conclusion.

We’ve also looked into fixing the Ashdillo Research Project for players playing with the peaceful modifier, if you know you know.

[b]HUB IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
Moving on we have a bunch of Hub improvements to report! 

You will now be able to move buildings in your base. As players expanded their bases a lot of you reported that the building placement wasn’t proper Feng Sui with your new real estate. So now if you’re unhappy with the placement of a building just pick it up and place it wherever your heart desires!

Hub inventory is now global, so any materials you gather or refine and then deposit in one Hub will now be usable in a base across the planet. Great for Co-op play! 

One of a kind constructions can be Deconstructed and placed elsewhere now and will show a special rule 'limited to one construction per development/region. 

The Builders, Botanists and Scientists will receive new houses to better emphasize their faction alignment, these houses will come with new icons as well. They also just look cooler!

A couple of constructions have been improved; The Exogarden has gotten an entirely new appearance and the Logistics center has been given exciting animations! 

We’ve also added an entirely new base building but it’s a secret that you will have to discover while playing!

[b]RESOURCES UPDATES[/b]
There will be an emphasis on what resources you gain and lose when you build things and a pop up showing the reputation you'll have in the region.
 There are no more local resources, so no more shipping costs.  Minerals, Metals, Organics, Synthetics, Machinery, Biofuel and Electronics are now all global.

Expertise, Appeal and Worker slots are still local though. Real estate is all about Location, after all!

To aid you, and to increase the importance of money, a market will be added to the Hub, to help you trade when you don't have the resources you need.

[b]UI IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
The UI in general has gotten a pretty hefty update. 

First off we've added a top bar to show you what resources you have while in the Hub.  

The help sections have been overhauled, the text turned into articles, that will show up for the player when they are relevant. These will feature images so the information is presented more clearly. 

When you hover over world features with constructions you see what it costs and what it yields. 
 The teleporter will now show more information when you teleport as well. Hub and region information will be displayed.  We’ve added communication to nudge Players to start a new prospect when finishing a scenario. And finally a lot of text has been updated for clarity.

[b]PLAYER TOOLS[/b]
The Jackhammer’s mining speed is now increased! Giving further incentive to invest in and carry one. 

The Buggy will now no longer protect you from damage, after all, it doesn’t quite make sense that an open vehicle would protect you from the hazards of Space Realty life.

[b]WRAP UP[/b]
These are the main features that will be added in the upcoming update Lift Off along with a bunch of bug fixes and tweaks.

If we review our Living Road Map we’ll be heading straight into content production mode as we enter the production milestone for the Red Planet ”Hellnera”. 

We would want to thank everyone who has played the game and participated during our first month of Early Access. With this update and with your feedback we feel we have a solid foundation to start adding fun content to!

We hope you enjoy the update! 

Thank you for playing and see you in space! 🚀
/Toby

notes.title: Patch Deployed
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Space realtors![/b]

We're back with another batch of improvements. Thanks again to everyone who have been sending us feedback and bug reports on either of our channels. It's greatly appreciated and helps us get the game sorted and finished faster. :)

This patch is focused almost entirely on general improvements and fixes.


[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Holograms are no longer animated, making it easier to read their size and position.
[*] Increased the amount of Azure Stones that may spawn in the world.
[*] Added an option in the settings menu that disables the music played while driving.
[*] Implemented new notifications that popup when Events and Projects are updated.
[*] Reduced the giant size of Kits while placed on Kit hangers.
[*] Improved the colliders of numerous constructions.
[*] Flowers no longer look like they are trying to strangle a player when they walk through them.
[*] Adjusted the size of Verdant Mounds and Biodomes.
[*] Gave the Mechanoid the ability to speak after they had moved in.
[*] Added an error message when trying to build a construction if the maximum amount already exists.
[*] Added "Low on food" warning when having only 1 food remaining.
[*] Added a hotkey-hint for the tool swap function in the main HUD while using Keyboard & Mouse.
[*] Made tenant dialogue boxes more readable.
[*] Made it easier to select the teleporter destinations when using the teleporter map.
[*] Made various adjustments to tenant visuals and their animations.
[*] Minor improvements to some icons and the styling of certain UIs and texts.
[*] Numerous localization improvements.
[/list]
[h3]Squashed bugs:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Hub upgrade did not expand the buildable zone correctly.
[*] The Mechanoid's house could not be placed again after the player removed it.
[*] Players did not always spawn at the hub nearest to their last location.
[*] Players could gain points from accomplished events every time they loaded a save.
[*] The Professor' sometimes cloned themselves, resulting in one Professor running around in panic, while the other was screaming from the rooftops.
[*] Space rot sometimes refused to disappear.
[*] The Ashbushel Icon wasn't visible to clients in co-op.
[*] The Hub resource info wasn't always loading properly.
[*] The location for Expedition Huts were not always visible on the map.
[*] Players could permanently end up in a rag-doll state if they smashed into each other while driving vehicles.
[*] Players could become invisible if they spammed the Equip/Holster button while recovering from a ragdoll state.
[*] Co-op clients sometimes had their cursor disappear after teleporting when using keyboard & mouse.
[*] Co-op clients couldn't speak with tenants.
[*] Co-op clients and hosts got different versions of tenants spawning.
[/list]

Finally - a friendly reminder that our release discount will end after this weekend. Go grab yourself a copy, or convince your friends if you already have one, for a neat 20% off before the 13th! :D


See you in space! 🚀

notes.title: Hotfix Deployed
notes.content:
We have just deployed our first hotfix for the game! This should resolve some of the issues we received reports of during these first couple of days in the wild, along with some minor improvements and adjustments.


[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the option to manually switch which audio device the game should be using.
[*] Made Ashbushel trees more likely to spawn in the starting region.
[*] Added a clarification on the codex page of World Features that cannot be improved with a building.
[*] Added a link in the main menu to the feedback survey.
[*] Changed the default keybind of Inventory to "I" instead of "B".
[*] Changed the timing of some UI pop ups.
[*] Updated some texts and requirement descriptions related to the S.I.T. project for clarity.
[*] Numerous and minor text adjustments.
[/list]
[h3]Squashed bugs:[/h3]
[list]
[*] A multiplayer user could lose the ability to drop samples from their inventory.
[*] The Hot Spring sometimes didn't spawn in the first region while the Australic modifier was enabled.
[*] Keybind icons could disappear while playing the game with language set to Russian.
[*] The Fancy Wrench, unlocked with the Supporter Pack, did not appear properly ingame.
[*] A few more quirks and issues of low severity.
[*] The big showdown in the S.I.T project did not activate for some players.
[*] UI pop-ups from completed research projects could remain stuck on screen. 
[/list]

We really appreciate all the feedback and bug-reports that you have sent in so far - we've got the whole team fired up, working on future fixes and improvements! :)


See you in space! 🚀

notes.title: Demo Localization update
notes.content:
By popular demand, we have now made the Space for Sale demo available in the following ten languages:
[list]
[*] Chinese (Simplified & Traditional)
[*] French
[*] German
[*] Indonesian
[*] Italian
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean
[*] Brazilian Portuguese
[*] Russian
[*] Spanish
[/list]
For all our gamepad users out there without a keyboard, we have also implemented a virtual keyboard that should pop up as soon when you try to edit some kind of text field. Please note that this requires the game to run in Big Picture mode.

We hope to see even more of you join in the fun and test the game leading up to the Early Access release.

See you in space! 🚀
